recipe.name: Moloch / Petrobond / Silver 925
recipe.calibration_note: Starting values; verify with shop trials

manufacturing.bench_notes: Two-part Petrobond pour parting on the crest line. The crest thorns and the head straddle the parting plane; the horns, flank thorns, side thorns and legs stand along the pull. Dress the seam between the crest thorns with a needle file and keep every thorn's flat tip.
